promptState.text: A real photograph of the sunny white terrace from <Picture 1>, now with a woman and her cat on it. The red-haired woman from <Picture 2> sits in the wicker armchair, relaxed and leaning back a little, smiling at the camera. She wears the white and orange baseball cap with the orange "PIXA" letters from <Picture 4>, peak facing forward, her copper-red hair falling out from under it to her chin, the same mustard yellow t-shirt as in <Picture 2>, light blue jeans and white canvas sneakers. The orange tabby cat from <Picture 3> lies curled on her lap with its front paws tucked under its chest, its head up, looking at the camera. Her left hand rests on the cat's back and her right hand lies on the armrest of the chair. Keep the terrace from <Picture 1>: the white house wall, the blue door, the blue shutters, the red tile roof, the stone floor, the small wooden table with the potted aloe and the blue sea behind. The same bright afternoon sun as in <Picture 1> lights her face, the cat's fur and the cap, with a soft shadow of the chair on the stone floor. Shot at eye level with a 50mm lens at f/4 from a few steps back, the woman in the chair in the middle of the picture from the top of the cap to her feet. Keep her face and freckles from <Picture 2>, the cat's stripes and white chest from <Picture 3>, and the cap's shape and lettering from <Picture 4>. A clean, high-resolution photograph from a full-frame camera, with smooth, even tonal gradations in the skin and fine natural detail.

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 MiniMax H3 Image needs ComfyUI 0.45.0 or newer, the first version with these nodes. On an older ComfyUI the nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors19.5 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/h3

Create the h3 folder if it does not exist.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors14.6 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

The same text encoder as MiniMax H3 video: if you did Episode 41 you already have it.

 Load VAE

Download minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors1.09 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

 License

MiniMax H3 Image has its own license, the MiniMax-H3-Image Community License, separate from the MiniMax H3 video license. Read it and check what it says for your country before you use the model: some countries need a license from MiniMax first.

READ LICENSE MiniMax H3 Image model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.183). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Give MiniMax H3 Image a few pictures of different things and say how to put them together. The demo takes four: a Greek terrace, a woman, a cat and a cap. Out comes one new photo: the woman in the cap, sitting on the terrace with the cat on her lap.

 Steps

  1. Load the place in the first Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1). The result takes the shape of this picture.
  2. Load the person (2), the animal (3) and the hat (4).
  3. Write how they come together in Prompt Pixaroma: <Picture 1> to <Picture 4> are the four pictures, in this order.
  4. Click a size on Number Pick Pixaroma: 16 megapixels is the demo. With four pictures, 4 and 8 save only 10 to 15 seconds.
  5. Leave the seed on F to repeat a result, or switch it to R to try a new one every Run.
  6. Press Run.

 Writing the prompt

  1. Start with the place: A real photograph of the sunny white terrace from <Picture 1>, now with a woman and her cat on it.
  2. Bring in each thing by its picture number, with one clear job: The orange tabby cat from <Picture 3> lies curled on her lap.
  3. Give every hand a job: Her left hand rests on the cat's back and her right hand lies on the armrest of the chair.
  4. Name every piece of clothing, also what no picture shows. Her picture shows only her t-shirt, so the demo adds light blue jeans and white canvas sneakers.
  5. End with what to keep from each picture: her face and freckles from <Picture 2>, the cat's stripes and white chest from <Picture 3>, and the cap's shape and lettering from <Picture 4>.

 Good to know

  • In all four test seeds the woman, the cap with "PIXA" spelled right, the cat on her lap and the terrace all came through. The camera distance changed with the seed: on one seed she sat far away and small. Try a few seeds.
  • The cat and the cap come on plain white backgrounds, so only the thing itself is in the picture. The cat is our own picture, a real-looking orange tabby made with workflow 1.
  • Want a fifth thing? Connect another Load Image Mini Pixaroma to the next empty image slot on the conditioning, and call it <Picture 5> in the prompt.
  • More pictures take longer: four pictures take about 40 seconds at 16 megapixels, one picture (workflow 3) about 27. See Run Times.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (MiniMax H3 Image) - MiniMax H3 Image, the picture model made by MiniMax itself. It is a different file from the H3 video models of Episode 41 and from P-H3 Image of Episode 42.
  • Load CLIP (MiniMax H3 text encoder) - Reads your prompt. It is the same Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder as MiniMax H3 video, so if you did Episode 41 you already have it. The type must be minimax.
  • Load VAE (MiniMax H3 Image VAE) - Turns the finished render into the picture. It is made for MiniMax H3 Image, a different file from the H3 video VAE and the P-H3 Image VAE.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. the place) - <Picture 1> in the prompt: the place. The result takes the shape of this picture. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (2. the person) - <Picture 2> in the prompt: the person.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (3. the animal) - <Picture 3> in the prompt: the animal. The demo cat is our own picture, made with workflow 1.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (4. the hat) - <Picture 4> in the prompt: the hat.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (5. how to put them together) - Say how the four pictures come together, using <Picture 1> to <Picture 4>, then what to keep from each (see How to Use).
  • Number Pick Pixaroma (6. megapixels) - How big the result is. Click 4, 8 or 16 (the demo) megapixels. The result takes the shape of the first picture, the place: the demo comes out at 4096 x 4096. A smaller size is faster.
  • Seed Pixaroma (7. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) repeats the result, R (random) tries a new one every Run. The demo uses seed 3.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Scale Image to Total Pixels (scales your picture) - Scales your picture to the size you clicked on Number Pick Pixaroma, on the model's 32 pixel grid.
  • Get Image Size (the size of the result) - Reads the size of the scaled picture and hands it to the conditioning, so the result comes out that big. Without it the result would stop at 2048 pixels on its short side.
  • MiniMax H3 Image Conditioning (prompt + your four pictures) - Joins the prompt, your four pictures and the size from Get Image Size. The first picture goes in at the size you clicked, the others as they are. A new empty slot appears under the last connected one, for a fifth picture.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (no negative prompt) - An empty negative. The model takes no negative prompt, and CFG stays at 1.
  • KSampler (6 steps, CFG 1) - The render: 6 steps, CFG 1, euler and simple, as MiniMax made the model. In our tests 10 steps made skin worse, and the er_sde sampler made it noisy, so leave these as they are.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the result) - Saves each result as PNG into ComfyUI/output/MiniMax H3 Image Elements and shows it on the node.
  • Image Compare Pixaroma (the place before and after) - The place and the result on top of each other. Drag across it to see what came in.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: a smaller picture is faster.

SizeTime
4 megapixelsabout 25 s
8 megapixels25 to 33 s
16 megapixels (the demo)about 40 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models (about 35 GB: 19.5 GB for the model, 14.6 GB for the text encoder and 1 GB for the VAE), so it takes longer. After that they stay in memory, if your PC has enough of it.

 On a smaller card

Click 4 or 8 on Number Pick Pixaroma.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
